One batter. A handful of ingredients. Generations of Algerians grew up eating Garantita from street vendors, and it's still one of the country's most iconic comfort foods. Have you tried it before? Mix 1 part chickpea flour with about 3 parts water until you have a very thin batter, similar to crêpe batter. Season with salt, 2–3 tbsp olive oil (or neutral oil) and ½ tsp cumin (optional). Whisk until completely smooth, then pour into a well-oiled shallow baking tray. Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C fan (190–200°C conventional) for 25–40 minutes, depending on the thickness, until the top is lightly golden and the centre is set with a slight wobble. Serve hot with ground cumin, harissa and plenty of fresh bread. #karantika #garantita #algeria #streetfood #1millionviews
